text:
incident-bot: Paging: SLI alert - GPU host thermal throttling causing 5xxs on /v1/generate (p95 latency > 2s, error rate spike). Severity: high. @marta_oncall paged.

marta_oncall: Got the page, joining. Can someone confirm which pool is affected?

jamie_sre: Seeing errors from eu-west-2 pool nodes node-gpu-12/13. Kernel temp jumps before process OOMs. Logs attached: `journalctl -u redwood-runtime | tail -n 200`.

alex_runtime: Confirmed. Recent canary rollout (deploy 6178800000) added a tiny perf reg that increases sustained GPU utilisation for certain prompt shapes. Probable contributor.

lina_pm: Any customer impact? Support dashboard shows ~18 customers with increased error rates, mostly embeddings and batch-gen jobs.

tess_support: Notifying top 5 currently affected customers via status page template, marking as degradation. Escalating to enterprise support.

marta_oncall: Short-term mitigation: enable feature-flag `new-batching-v2` -> OFF in eu-west-2 for canary ring A. deploy-bot: please run flag kill.

deploy-bot: Running flag toggle: `redwood flags set eu-west-2 new-batching-v2 false --scope canaryA`... DONE (request id r-9f8c).

jamie_sre: After flag flip, seeing decrease in GPU temp spikes on node-gpu-12. Error rate trending down. Telemetry: errors dropped from 7.8% -> 1.1% in 3 mins.

alex_runtime: Good. Plan: we should revert the single commit that introduced the batching change (commit 7a4d2c3) and push a micro-patch with a safety guard. Prefer revert + hotfix to avoid reintroducing perf reg.

marta_oncall: Can someone run a quick canary revert PR to dedicated CanaryA? I can own verification.

alex_runtime: Opening revert PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/commit/revert-7a4d2c3. CI light green, deploying to canaryA.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (deploy id d-6178901240). Rolling per-policy 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Will stop on failures.

marta_oncall: Monitoring. Early metrics show p95 latency back to baseline on canary traffic.

jamie_sre: Recommend follow-up: create a thermal watchdog in runtime to back off batching when sustained GPU temp > 85C for 30s. I'll spin up a ticket.

lina_pm: Agree. Also need customer follow-ups. Tess, coordinate postmortem comms and explain rollback/hotfix.

tess_support: On it. Drafting status update: "Degradation resolved after rolling back canary change; follow-up patch planned. No persistent data loss. Customers on affected routes may have experienced increased latency/5xx between 08:12–08:22 UTC." Will share for review.

marta_oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes + next steps. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update: status set to MITIGATED by marta_oncall at 6178901500. Paging channel cleared.

jamie_sre: Action items: 1) Hotfix PR with guard (alex) 2) Thermal watchdog (jamie) 3) Postmortem draft (lina/tess). I'll attach logs and graphs to the postmortem ticket.

alex_runtime: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/pull/891 - small change + test. Targeting patch release in next 30m once smoke verified.

marta_oncall: Thanks team. I'll handoff to on-call follow-up in case anything reoccurs.

lina_pm: Thanks everyone. Notifying CS and account teams separately.
